<!-- Shared by contribute.qmd and es/contribute.qmd. -->
<p class="lead-sm" data-t="contributeIntro"></p>

<div class="kind-picker" role="radiogroup">
  <label class="kind-card">
    <input type="radio" name="kind" value="dataset">
    <span class="kind-title" data-t="kindDataset"></span>
    <span class="kind-text" data-t="kindDatasetText"></span>
  </label>
  <label class="kind-card">
    <input type="radio" name="kind" value="paper">
    <span class="kind-title" data-t="kindPaper"></span>
    <span class="kind-text" data-t="kindPaperText"></span>
  </label>
</div>

<form id="submit-form" hidden>
  <h2 id="form-title"></h2>
  <label for="doi" data-t="doi"></label>
  <input id="doi" name="doi" required placeholder="10.5061/dryad.abc123">
  <button type="button" id="check" class="btn btn-outline-primary mt-2" data-t="check"></button>
  <div id="preview"></div>

  <label for="sector" data-t="sectorPick"></label>
  <select id="sector" name="sector">
    <option value=""></option>
    <option>Santa Rosa</option><option>Murciélago</option><option>Pocosol</option>
    <option>Junquillal</option><option>Horizontes</option><option>Guanacaste</option>
    <option>Rincón de la Vieja</option><option>Pitilla</option><option>Cacao</option>
    <option>Maritza</option><option>San Cristóbal</option><option>Del Oro</option>
    <option>Santa Elena</option><option>Marino</option><option>Other / Otro</option>
  </select>

  <label for="note" id="note-label"></label>
  <textarea id="note" name="note" rows="3" maxlength="1000"></textarea>

  <label for="contact" data-t="contact"></label>
  <input id="contact" name="contact" type="email" maxlength="200">

  <div class="cf-turnstile mt-3" data-sitekey="0x4AAAAAAFj54k2qSoWe4-yj"></div>
  <button type="submit" id="submit-btn" class="btn btn-primary mt-3"></button>
  <p id="status" role="status" class="mt-3"></p>
</form>

<script src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js" async defer></script>
<script type="module">
import { strings } from "/assets/strings.js";
const WORKER = "https://acg-catalog-submit.catherine-hulshof.workers.dev";
const lang = document.documentElement.lang === "es" ? "es" : "en";
const root = lang === "es" ? "../" : "./";
const t = strings[lang];
document.querySelectorAll("[data-t]").forEach(el => el.textContent = t[el.dataset.t]);
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const say = msg => $("status").textContent = msg;
const esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
const normDoi = s => String(s || "").trim().toLowerCase()
  .replace(/^(https?:\/\/)?(dx\.)?doi\.org\//, "").replace(/^doi:\s*/, "");

// Entries already published, to tell people before they submit a duplicate
const published = Promise.all(["catalog", "papers"].map(f =>
  fetch(`${root}data/${f}.json`).then(r => r.json()).catch(() => []))).then(([data, papers]) =>
  new Map([...data.map(d => [d.doi, d]), ...papers.map(d => [d.doi, d])].filter(([k]) => k)));

let kind = null;
function pick(k) {
  kind = k;
  document.querySelectorAll("input[name=kind]").forEach(r => {
    r.checked = r.value === k;
    r.closest(".kind-card").classList.toggle("selected", r.checked);
  });
  $("submit-form").hidden = false;
  $("form-title").textContent = k === "paper" ? t.kindPaper : t.kindDataset;
  $("note-label").textContent = k === "paper" ? t.notePaper : t.note;
  $("submit-btn").textContent = k === "paper" ? t.submitPaper : t.submitDataset;
  $("doi").placeholder = k === "paper" ? "10.1111/btp.12345" : "10.5061/dryad.abc123";
  $("preview").innerHTML = ""; say("");
  history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + k);
}
document.querySelectorAll("input[name=kind]").forEach(r => r.addEventListener("change", () => pick(r.value)));
if (["#dataset", "#paper"].includes(location.hash)) pick(location.hash.slice(1));

$("check").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  $("preview").innerHTML = ""; say("");
  const have = (await published).get(normDoi($("doi").value));
  const r = await fetch(`${WORKER}/api/resolve?doi=${encodeURIComponent($("doi").value)}`);
  const j = await r.json();
  if (!j.ok) return say(j.error === "invalid_doi" ? t.invalid : t.notFound);
  const m = j.metadata;
  const mismatch = kind === "dataset" && !m.is_dataset ? t.notDataset
                 : kind === "paper" && m.is_dataset ? t.notPaper : "";
  $("preview").innerHTML = `<div class="dataset-card"><strong>${t.found}</strong>
    <h4>${esc(m.title)}</h4><div class="dataset-meta">${esc(m.creators)} · ${esc(m.year)} · ${esc(m.publisher)}</div>
    ${mismatch ? `<p class="text-warning mb-0">${mismatch}</p>` : ""}
    ${have ? `<p class="mb-0">${t.inAtlas} <em>${esc(have.title)}</em></p>` : ""}
    ${j.already ? `<p class="mb-0">${t.already} ${esc(j.already)}</p>` : ""}</div>`;
});

$("submit-form").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const token = document.querySelector("[name='cf-turnstile-response']")?.value;
  if (!token) return say(t.captcha);
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`${WORKER}/api/submit`, {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ doi: $("doi").value, kind, sector: $("sector").value,
        note: $("note").value, contact: $("contact").value, lang, turnstileToken: token })
    });
    const j = await r.json();
    if (j.ok && j.duplicate) return say(`${t.already} ${j.status}`);
    if (j.ok) { say(t.thanks); e.target.reset(); return; }
    say({ invalid_doi: t.invalid, not_found: t.notFound, captcha: t.captcha, rate_limited: t.rateLimited }[j.error] || t.error);
  } catch { say(t.error); }
});
</script>
